title: Wild AG numbered pill row
description: A wide pill link 80px tall with a 2px soft outline: a filled number disc at the left, a bold label, and a thin arrow at the right. On hover the outline melts away, the pill tints and the arrow nudges right. A light version for paper surfaces and an outlined-in-paper version for gradient bands.
notes: tone 'band' is for the gradient bands (paper outline, paper disc)
